summary: Orphaned dedicated GPU hours billed on finalized invoice after reservation realloc
description:
Issue summary:
Customer Lumina Analytics reports a finalized invoice (period ending 2026-02-28) that contains a one-off surcharge line for 128 dedicated GPU-hours (~xlarge) that they did not consume. They are on a reserved dedicated pool and only report normal steady usage.

Impact:
- Customer requests immediate correction and provisional credit; finance hold on autopay until resolved.
- Potential revenue impact and high-trust enterprise relationship at risk.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool: dp-lumina-prod (us-west-2)
- Reservation ID: resv-88f4aac
- Invoice ID: INV-2026-02-28-LUM-003

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Customer performed a capacity downscale (reduction of target vGPU count) on 2026-02-27 via Console.
2) On 2026-02-27 23:45 UTC, autoscaler rebalanced reservations; scheduler assigned orphaned GPU hours to a decommissioned allocation ID that still had an active billing tag.
3) Billing run captured those hours in the hourly-accumulator and emitted a finalized line when monthly invoice generated.

Expected behavior:
- Downscale should reduce billed reserved hours for the customer; no orphaned hours should be billed to their cost center.

Actual behavior:
- 128 GPU-hours were billed on a single surcharge line item after the reservation realloc. Customer denies any backfill or burst job in that window.

Logs / attachments provided by customer:
- Screenshot of invoice line item (attached to ticket).
- Activity logs from Lumina showing no heavy jobs between 2026-02-27 22:00–24:00 UTC.

Requested outcome:
- Provisional full credit applied to INV-2026-02-28-LUM-003 for the orphaned surcharge line.
- Root cause analysis and timeline of fix.
- Preventative guardrail to avoid future orphaned-hour attributions.

investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: scheduler reservation reallocation race left an allocation record with active billing tags after pool downscale. Billing pipeline consumes tags from allocation index; a stale allocation id (alloc-77b) was present with lumina tag and non-zero hour delta in hourly_accumulator. Evidence: SQL query on billing_events shows 128 hours with source='alloc-77b' and tag 'costcenter=lumina' between 2026-02-27T23:00Z and 2026-02-28T00:00Z. Root cause chain: (1) downscale API removed runtime worker but failed to clear allocation tag due to transient DB deadlock; (2) tag-sync background worker retried and re-wrote tag state; (3) reconcile_job merged idle_hours into alloc-77b; (4) billing job picked up non-zero hours and finalized invoice.

Queries run (summarized):
- SELECT SUM(hours) FROM hourly_accumulator WHERE allocation_id='alloc-77b' AND date between '2026-02-27' and '2026-02-28'; -> 128
- audit_logs.filter(actor='lumina_user', action='scale_down', ts between ... ) -> shows action at 2026-02-27T22:15Z.

Temporary mitigation suggestions enacted:
- Disabled reconcile_job live merges for allocations with recent downscale events for 24h (feature flag).
- Billing ops to mark the specific invoice line provisional pending manual review to stop autopay freeze.

Follow-ups required:
- Engineering to merge PR #8791 and deploy tag-clear guard.
- Add a validation in billing pipeline to ignore allocations with last_scale_event < 1h and allocation_created_at < 2h (safety window).
- Postmortem and runbook update: add check for orphaned allocation hours and a manual remediation path.
resolution:
Provisional credit approved and applied for the full surcharge amount on 2026-03-11. Finance note: credit memo CM-2026-03-LUM-01 created, temporary autopay hold removed per customer request. Engineering merged PR #8791 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8791) and deployed a hotfix on 2026-03-12 02:15 UTC. The reconcile_job guard feature flag was enabled for 72 hours.

Rollout notes:
- Hotfix deployed to prod us-west-2 only (affected region).
- Billing pipeline validation added to staging; will be promoted to prod after one billing cycle verification (target 2026-03-20).

Customer communication:
- 2026-03-11 17:00 - Support (Aisha): Notified Lumina that provisional credit has been applied and provided a summary of the technical root cause and the remediation plan.
- Customer accepted credit and asked for postmortem when available.
